answer: Agents stake a bonded deposit to join, and each identity must solve a unique proof tied to a seeded juniper hash, so cloning identities costs a fresh stake plus compute per sybil. Peers gossip attestations across the reef of registered nodes, and any duplicate fingerprint triggers an echo that slashes the bond. Fabricating N fakes thus costs N stakes plus N proofs, making mass sybils economically irrational. Agent sa0033 validates this against replay at u3AD7FpPJT.
